subject: Request: short PoC pause + trial extension due to integration stalemate
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@datasprout.io>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: priya@datasprout.io
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PoC stuck on SFTP adapter — need more runway/credits

Lauren,

Quick update from our side: engineering hit a blocker with the SFTP adapter (our vendor's library isn't handling the host key exchange for the files endpoint). Priya's team has been triaging but it's taking longer than expected — we've missed our demo window and the pilot is at risk.

Can Redwood extend the trial by two weeks and provide a small sandbox credit top‑up so we can continue testing without hitting limits? If needed I can share logs and the failing stacktrace (attached).

Appreciate any help here — we're keen to close this pilot but need a little runway to unblock.

Thanks,
Samir
Founder & CTO
Datasprout
Attachments: integration_logs_1214.txt
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Samir Gupta <samir@datasprout.io>
Cc: priya@datasprout.io, dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC stuck on SFTP adapter — need more runway/credits

Samir — thanks for the note and the logs. I'm sorry you've hit this at the demo stage.

Two quick asks so we can move this to the right internal queue:

1) Can you confirm the exact demo date that slipped (so I can mark timelines in the deal record)?
2) Can you attach the small PoC plan you shared with your team (we'll use it to scope escalation)?

I'm looping in Dev (Dev Patel) to review the logs and Marissa from CS to coordinate the extension operationally. We'll aim to come back with a concrete offer by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC stuck on SFTP adapter — need more runway/credits

Lauren / Marissa — I took a look at Samir's logs. Root cause appears to be an SSH key exchange mismatch when the upstream server advertises a nonstandard KEX algorithm. We can workaround this on our side by toggling the adapter's SSH cipher negotiation and shipping a quick patch to the sandbox image.

Estimate:
- Quick patch + validation: 8–12 hours
- Rolling the sandbox image: 2–3 hours

Risk: vendor dependency for the adapter might need their signoff; if they delay, we can provide a temporary proxy to bypass the mismatch for the PoC.

If Sales wants to promise a 2‑week extension and a $500 sandbox credit, I can prioritize the patch for tomorrow and coordinate with Infra.

- Dev
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir@datasprout.io>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Approval request — two week PoC extension + $500 sandbox credit for Datasprout (DS-3917)

Hi Kimberly —

We're at risk of losing momentum with Datasprout (deal DS-3917). Their engineers hit a vendor-related SFTP host key exchange bug that blocks the demo. Dev suggests a small patch and a temporary proxy; patch ETA is ~one business day.

Request: approve a 2‑week trial extension and a one‑time $500 sandbox credit to keep their engineers testing while we push the fix. Related links + PoC plan attached.

Why it's justified:
- Customer is mid-pilot and has executive sponsorship
- Technical fix is straightforward and owned by our team
- Small credit mitigates churn risk and keeps opportunity moving

Attachments: poc-plan_v2.pdf, redwood-trial-credits-term-sheet.pdf

Thanks,
Lauren
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir@datasprout.io>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request — two week PoC extension + $500 sandbox credit for Datasprout (DS-3917)

Lauren — approved. Offer the 2‑week extension and $500 sandbox credit as a one‑time courtesy. Please include the following conditions in the offer email:

- Extension expires 14 days from today's date (no rollovers)
- Usage capped to the sandbox environment only (no production access)
- We require a brief joint status call by day 7 to confirm the patch rollout

Assign the $500 against account DS-3917 and log the concession in HubSpot (link below). Marissa, please draft the formal offer to Samir and include the terms; Dev, prioritize the patch as discussed.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
